definition: BaseX is an XML database and XQuery processor for storing and querying structured documents.
entry_text: BaseX is an XML database and XQuery processor for storing and querying structured documents.
example: A publishing team retrieves sections of manuals by querying their XML markup.
label: BaseX

sources.note: The project describes both the XML database and XQuery processor, including storage and querying of XML documents. XML is a core capability, not the only supported data format.
